newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks drop sharply as bonds plunge.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks drop sharply as bonds plunge.

text.p: Madrid stocks closed sharply lower on Friday after Spanish bonds took a plunge as rumours about the European single currency integration process rattled markets in Spain and Italy.
The general index fell 4.32 points, 0.92 percent, to 465.18 and the Ibex-35 lost 52.09 points, 0.97 percent, to 5,305.43.
"It's been a pretty nervous session, with heavy sales in late trade. In my opinion, our market foundation does not justify these movements," one analyst said.

Dealers said the market support for the Ibex index of 35 leading shares was at about 5,200 and could extend down to 5,100, but interest rate prospects and market fundamentals were favourable and they did not see the support being threatened.
Trading volume reached nearly 80 billion pesetas.
The food sector was the only one to see gains with a 0.23 percent rise helped by Tabacalera and Campofrio, in particular.
